title: The Patience of Bees
text:
Honeybees prepare for a winter they have never seen.[12] A colony stores far more honey in summer than it could ever eat before the cold arrives.

Foragers choose flowers by the reward they carry, and they share what they find with the rest of the hive through a dance that points the way.

When the cold comes, the bees cluster around the queen and shiver their flight muscles to keep the centre of the cluster warm.
